worldcombat.skill.sandattack.summary: Kicks sand into a short aimed fan, weakening enemies’ melee attack power and lowering their accuracy stages.
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.use.0: Blind a whole line of foes at point-blank
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.use.1: Set up a melee or a retreat
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.use.2: Kick sand into a narrow doorway to blind the pursuers
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.description: Blinding lasts %2$s and reduces melee attack power by 16%. It also lowers accuracy by %1$s stages; those stage changes remain until encounter recovery or removal.

Scatters sand %1$s blocks along the aim over a %2$s-degree fan, affecting up to four enemies. It can lock a foe or be kicked at empty air; with nobody caught the sand only reaches the fan's end. Walls and cover truncate the fan. The displayed area and duration include the selected grit.

Scraping the ground takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. The grit takes its colour from the block underfoot: sand yellow, gravel grey, mud brown. The fan is short and points one way only, so stepping aside or retreating behind cover avoids it.
worldcombat.skill.sandattack.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
Coarse: angle x1.35 and blind duration x1.3, but the fan is 0.8 blocks shorter, the wind-up 3 ticks longer and cooldown x1.1; Fine: angle x0.85 and duration x0.8, but the fan reaches 0.8 blocks further, winds up 3 ticks faster and cooldown x0.95.
The companion only considers sand attack while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it for point-blank work, larger chases out.
It holds the move until this many visible enemies stand in the fan; set 1 to throw at any sighting, higher to wait for a line.
When on, the companion may leave its post to throw sand under a Hold order.
